evidence.rationale: No data yet, so slots test the goal-relevant literature hypotheses (H6, H5, H7, H8, H2); H4 parked because their regions cannot meet the spec. || planner: Round 1, no measurements. Seed with the agent-generated H7 (low-Sn gap) and H8 (low-Sn, Cs-rich stability), which target the joint window. Include a Pb-only Cs/FA baseline (H5) as a cheap control, since Pb films cost 1.0 versus 1.5 for Sn. Critic caveats noted: Cs is unconstrained in H7 and Sn/Cs are confounded in H8, so I will vary Cs across slots.
slots: Test H6: MA-majority films are thermally unstable.
Test H5: Cs/FA double-cation Pb iodides are the stable baseline.
Test H7: Low-Sn (15-30%), Br-free, MA-free Cs/FA films reach the target bandgap window (1.24-1.38 eV) while staying below the Sn-Pb bowing region that H2 covers.
Test H8: Cs-FA films with 10-30% Sn and Cs 0.15-0.3 have log10 T80 above 2.7 (T80 > 500 h), challenging H3.
Test H2: Sn-Pb mixing bows the bandgap below both end members.

evidence.rationale: Replicate 1 spec-meeting film(s) before claiming a discovery; model now gives P(hit) up to 42%, so most films go to exploitation. || planner: Round 2. E001 is a measured hit (1.365 eV, 886 h) that the prior had at p_hit 0.025, so the Sn penalty in the model is too heavy. Exploit around E001: neighbours with Sn 0.2-0.3 and Cs <=0.1 to map the gap window (H9), plus a replicate of E001 for discovery status. Cost per Sn film is 1.5, with 54.5 units left.
slots: Test H2: Sn-Pb mixing bows the bandgap below both end members.

evidence.rationale: Replicate 2 spec-meeting film(s) before claiming a discovery; model now gives P(hit) up to 83%, so most films go to exploitation. || planner: Round 3. Replicated hit confirmed (Cs0.1FA0.9Pb0.8Sn0.2I3). E006 (Sn 0.3) is an unreplicated hit that contradicts H3, so replicate it and probe H10/H11 at Sn 0.3-0.5 with Cs 0.1-0.3. Sn films cost 1.5, with 50 units left, so I can afford a broad mapping round. Keep the MA question (H12) lower priority.
slots: Test H2: Sn-Pb mixing bows the bandgap below both end members.

evidence.rationale: Replicate 1 spec-meeting film(s) before claiming a discovery; re-run the surprising Cs0.3FA0.7Pb0.7Sn0.3I3 result (z = -2.2) to rule out noise; model now gives P(hit) up to 52%, so most films go to exploitation. || planner: Round 4, 42.5 units left. Three confirmed hits exist. Remaining uncertainty: (1) E011 (Sn 0.4, Cs 0.2, 1.258 eV/671 h) is single, so replicate it. (2) H13 Cs cliff between 0.2 and 0.3, so test Cs 0.15-0.25 at Sn 0.3-0.4. (3) H14 gap at Sn 0.5-0.6 with Cs 0.1-0.2 to find the lower gap edge at 1.24 eV. Prefer Cs<=0.2 designs and avoid Cs 0.3.
slots: Test H6: MA-majority films are thermally unstable.

evidence.rationale: 4 confirmed discoveries meet the goal; stopping to save 36.5 units of budget. || planner: Round 5, 36.5 units left. Several confirmed hits exist, so spend on (1) replicating E014 (Cs0.1 Sn0.4, 832 h, best T80), (2) the window's lower edge via Sn 0.5 at Cs 0.1 (H15), (3) the Br lever for gap centring (H17). Avoid Cs 0.3. Sn films cost 1.5.
